restaurant_name: ด้วยรักทันตกรรม
text: The service was excellent, and the clinic staff were incredibly friendly. During the procedure, the dentist explained the cause of the tartar buildup and how to prevent and manage it – nothing was held back. You can ask questions anytime. I went for a tartar removal (after many years!), and the dentist used a lot of force, but it wasn't painful at all. I was surprised, thinking my mouth would be bleeding when I rinsed (like at other clinics where my gums would be sore and swollen for days). But there were only two drops of blood, and no pain at all. The dentist's skill is top-notch! The clinic has a friendly atmosphere, reasonable prices, and accepts social security insurance. There's parking available in the alley next to the clinic. Overall, it's excellent! P.S. Most clients are by appointment, so it's best to call and book an appointment beforehand as the clinic is booked all day. 🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩
